CustomField.formula:
IF( ISBLANK(breg_Received_Date__c), "",
TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE(breg_Received_Date__c))) & " " &
CASE( MONTH(DATEVALUE(breg_Received_Date__c)), 1, "January", 2, "February", 3, "March", 4, "April", 5, "May", 6, "June", 7, "July", 8, "August", 9, "September", 10, "October", 11, "November", 12, "December", "" ) & " " &
TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(breg_Received_Date__c))) & " " &
IF( MOD(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(breg_Received_Date__c - (10/24))), 12) = 0, "12", TEXT(MOD(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(breg_Received_Date__c - (10/24))), 12)) ) & ":" &
IF( MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(breg_Received_Date__c - (10/24))) < 10, "0" & TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(breg_Received_Date__c - (10/24)))), TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(breg_Received_Date__c - (10/24)))) ) & " " &
IF( HOUR(TIMEVALUE(breg_Received_Date__c - (10/24))) < 12, "AM", "PM" ) )
CustomField.label: Received DateTime Text Formula
